text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to obtain approval to prohibit wide vehicles (greater than 2.0 metres in width) from travelling in the east-west laneway north of St. Clair Avenue West, between Silverthorn Avenue and Blackthorn Avenue. Prohibiting vehicles over 2.0 metres in width from travelling in the subject lane would be beneficial in reducing the incidence of damage to the adjacent private property.

Etobicoke York Community Council : 1. Approved the prohibition of vehicles over 2.0 metres in width from travelling in the east-west public laneway north of St. Clair Avenue West, between Silverthorn Avenue and Blackthorn Avenue.
